title: skills(pm-dispatch): a text-only DELIBERATE CORRECTION is confirmed by the dispatching seat's ACCEPT quoting before/after
body:
Fixes #23201

Clause-②: no

This implements item 4 of the maintainer's ruling on #23177 (ruling record `6139629628`, the maintainer's word 「同意」). A DELIBERATE CORRECTION whose diff changes only release text or comments is confirmed by the dispatching seat's ACCEPT. That ACCEPT names every edited note and quotes each rewritten sentence before and after. The second same-head review is dropped for that class. Everything else, code changes included, keeps the full procedure.

**Status: draft, with one named gap: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` is red at 102 lines against a ceiling of 101.** The ruled text needs one more line than this PR could pay for. Closing that gap takes a seat or maintainer decision; see *Line budget*.

## The change: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md`

Before (`afbf960c`, lines 15–16):

```text
- DELIBERATE CORRECTION 红(`check-empty-changeset`):同 head 达档复核 PASS 记录即确认,⛔ 不等维护者。
- 记录须点名被改 note、逐句判改写句,缺一不算;算即按 SKILL.md 三条件带红入队,门禁不改。
```

After (`92c8a276`, lines 14–17):

```text
- DELIBERATE CORRECTION 红(`check-empty-changeset`)⛔ 不等维护者;确认件皆须点名每个被改 note:
- diff 只改 release 文字或注释者:派发席 ACCEPT 确认,逐句引改前与改后,免第二次同 head 复核。
- 其余(含改代码)照全套:同 head 达档复核 PASS 记录即确认,记录逐句判改写句。
- 两类缺一不算;算即按 SKILL.md 三条件带红入队,门禁不改。
```

How the text maps to the ruling:

| Requirement | Where it sits now |
|:--|:--|
| No wait for the maintainer (kept) | line 14, `⛔ 不等维护者`, covers both classes |
| The confirmation names every edited note (kept, and now required of both classes) | line 14 |
| Text-only class: the dispatching seat's ACCEPT confirms and quotes each rewritten sentence before and after, with no second same-head review (new) | line 15 |
| Code changes keep the full procedure: a same-head at-tier review PASS record that judges each rewritten sentence (kept) | line 16 |
| An incomplete confirmation does not count (kept) | line 17 |
| Enqueue red under SKILL.md's three red-by-design conditions; `check-empty-changeset` unchanged (kept) | line 17. No file outside `landing-operations.md` is touched. |

Two readings I took:
- **"A comment's wording" means 注释 (a comment in code or in the changeset).** A diff cannot carry a comment from a PR thread.
- **The exemption is the narrow side.** The text class is named explicitly; every other diff, code changes included, falls to `其余(含改代码)照全套`. A diff the reader cannot place goes to the full procedure.

## Line budget: 101 → 102 lines (ceiling 101), RED

The dispatch assumed a net-0 rewrite in place with no limit on line length. That assumption does not hold. The ratchet caps every re-wrappable line at 120 bytes (`MAX_LINE_BYTES` in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`). The old lines 15 and 16 were already 118 B and 119 B.
- **The dispatch's suggested two-line wording does not fit.** It measures 210 B and 229 B. The ratchet's own `wrapLine` turns each into 2 lines, so 4 lines in total. I ran the gate's `scanLineLengths` once on those two lines to confirm; that was a one-off check and no file was kept.
- **No 3-line form works.** The tightest packing I could build, already dropping words, needs 358 B of content against 354 B of capacity. That is before each bullet has to end at a sentence boundary. Every 3-line candidate either overflowed a line or left the shared enqueue-and-gate clause reading as if it applied to the code class only.
- **So the ruled text takes 4 lines: +2.** All four are within the 120-byte cap (111 / 120 / 102 / 77 B), and the gate's line-length scan reports no offenders.

**One line is paid.** The clause-② block's former line 12 is deleted:

```text
- 交付后复核按面欠 ⛔ 不按车道(三面见 `references/contract-review.md`);双肢命中即 spec 车道。
```

Its content is stated elsewhere:
- "Owed by surface, not by lane" is `contract-review.md:7`.
- "A clause-② hit is spec-lane work" is `execution-duties.md:101`.
- This file still points to `contract-review.md` from section B (now line 56).

That leaves net +1.

**The second payment was not taken.** The candidate was the main-red ③ line (now `landing-operations.md:84`). AGENTS.md's Multi-agent discipline §7 states the same rule in full: "Main-red: a full-battery red is its lane's first work … ⛔ no lane PR arms the queue meanwhile". This session's permission check refused that deletion as outside the change's scope, and I did not retry it by any other route. ⛔ The ceiling is not raised here.

Ways to settle the gap:
- **A (seat):** authorize the second payment, deleting line 84, which AGENTS.md §7 restates. That is one more commit, and the ratchet goes green at 101/101.
- **B (maintainer):** grant a ruled raise from 101 to 102 under the ratchet's maintainer exit, quoting ruling `6139629628` item 4. The SKILL.md raises 811 → 812 and 812 → 813 are the precedent: ruled content that could not be paid in place. This needs the maintainer's word for the raise itself.
- **Not recommended:** a lossy 3-line form. It would drop either the `check-empty-changeset` anchor or the scope of the shared enqueue-and-gate clause.

## Not in this PR

The `rest-channel.md` line carried over from #23193 (ruling item 5) is not addressed here. I read the state on `origin/main` `4f5679c2`:
- `WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_ALLOWLIST` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` is still `['shard-timings-refresh.yml']`.
- PR #23209 is open (draft).
- `rest-channel.md` is at its own ceiling, 82/82.

That line belongs to the skills seat, once PR #23209 lands and a line is paid for in that file.

## Acceptance notes

- **What the exemption replaces.** It replaces only the DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmation. Two other requirements keep applying on their own terms:
  - the clause-② gate in the same block (line 9: either limb hit means an at-tier clause-② review PASS before the queue). A comment-only edit under `packages/spec/src/**` still hits the path limb.
  - the Tier S landing record.

  The four lines do not restate either; there was no room.
- **Consistent with existing text.** `contract-review.md:8-10` already sends `.changeset` prose to the dispatching seat's ACCEPT, checked sentence by sentence against the diff. The new text-only class matches it.
- **Drift observed, not acted on.** `landing-operations.md:59` says a Tier S PR lands after "落地前检三条" (three pre-landing checks). `contract-review.md:29` defines "落地前检两条" (two). carrier: none (承接者:无).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:落地细则里管「DELIBERATE CORRECTION」(改别人待发布的发布说明)的两行,改写成四行:只改发布说明文字或注释、完全不碰代码的更正,由派发席在 ACCEPT 里点名每个被改的 note、逐句贴出改前与改后原文即算确认,不再额外跑一次同 head 的复核子代理;凡改了代码(或判不准是否纯文字)的更正,照旧走完整的达档复核。为腾行数,删掉了同一段里一条在别处已写明的重复规则。

**为什么改**:维护者在 #23177 裁决 B 第 4 条说「同意」。上一次 12 行的 changeset 措辞更正,ACCEPT 已经逐句核过,还要再花约 10 分钟、约 20 万 token 做第二次复核,纯属重复劳动。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:风险在于把带代码的更正误当成纯文字类而少一次复核;文本按 PR 实际 diff 判类,只有明确属于「只改发布文字或注释」的才豁免,其余一律走全套,把豁免面压到最窄。代价:规则需要四行,而本文件行数上限是 101,只付得起一行,所以行数棘轮门禁目前是红的(102/101),要等下面的决定。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的提交。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:在两条路里选一条回复:A 同意再删一条与 AGENTS.md 重复的「main-red 约定③」行(棘轮回到 101/101);或 B 准许把本文件行数上限从 101 抬到 102。
